scoring.recovered: A structurally accepted type earns one unit once; duplicate entries, fitted rates, and extra members earn no additional credit.
scoring.baseline_present: Classify the generated baseline first; a type already present receives baseline coverage and zero revision credit.
scoring.secondary_metric: For each measured species, mean absolute log10(max(x_sim,L_s)/max(x_exp,L_s)) over its frozen rows; the overall score is the unweighted mean of species scores.
scoring.species_aggregation: Rows are equally weighted within species and species are equally weighted; report every per-species score and scored-row count.
scoring.zero_and_detection_limit_policy: L_s is the stated detection limit where supplied; otherwise half the smallest strictly positive frozen observation for that species. Exact zeros and values below L_s are clamped to L_s. A species with no positive value and no stated limit is refused, never assigned zero error.
refusals: missing or nonfinite simulated mole fraction
negative simulated or experimental mole fraction
species with no stated detection limit and no positive frozen observation
unsupported reactor condition or solver failure
scoring.locking: Lock candidate, baseline, contract hash, structural matcher, JSR adapter and simulator before one holdout evaluation; no holdout-driven retries, tuning or exclusions.

leakage_limits: v_new and the four Bugler2015 chemistry classes are shared with case 2; this tests transfer to a branched fuel, not an independent historical chemistry discovery.

The XML holdout bibliography is Zhong et al., Combustion and Flame 235 (2022) 111678, DOI 10.1016/j.combustflame.2021.111678. These authors differ from Bugler et al. and the study postdates the named 2015 revision, strengthening historical blindness; the maintained v_new bytes are not an authenticated 2015 snapshot, so absolute blindness is not established.
The shared ReSpecTh archive is a common curation channel, not independent evidence of chemistry.
Keep v_new, author glossary, mapped truth and labels out of revision prompts and retrieval until locking; score type recovery once with baseline credit, not rate or thermo tuning.
Korcek chemistry is excluded. Preserve all reader refusals, including all 121 development IDT points; this contract currently provides no reader-supported development observations.
Holdout includes pyrolysis x00011012 and oxidation x00011009-011 as one whole study. Its digitized numeric XML observations retain their provenance; no point is redigitized.
